title: Naomi Holds the Baby
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Boaz could see that Ruth was good,
So loyal, kind, and true.
He said, "Please be my wife, dear Ruth,"
And Ruth said, "Yes, I do."

[Chorus]
Keep being kind when days are hard,
For God sees all you do.
He turned Ruth's sadness into joy,
And He will bless you too.

[Verse 2]
They had a wedding full of joy,
And soon a baby came.
Naomi held him, laughing, glad,
And Obed was his name.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
So if today was hard, my love,
Just close your eyes and rest.
Heavenly Father sees your heart,
And He will send His best.

[Chorus]
mood: Blessing music. A gentle, lilting waltz sways under the voice, warm and open, like a wedding morning and a grandmother rocking a newborn in her arms. The first verses glow with quiet gladness, the sway full and easy, as sadness turns to joy. By the last verse the waltz grows softer and slower, settling low, the way a family finally rests once everything has come right.
